title: PMM Developmental Form Atlas repository governance bootstrap and R1T pre-gate materialisation

authority_source.instruction: Place a bounded PMM-DFA bootstrap/materialisation packet under repository governance

purpose: Create the missing repository court record required to govern PMM-DFA and permit a later PMM-DFA-R1T-G0 preparation run without granting the reserved candidate-freeze or protected-Development authorities.
scope: Bind already-filed Laboratory PMM R0/R1/R2/R2R/R4 evidence and PMM-DFA formal synthesis by Catalogue artifact identity, Drive identity where verified, and SHA-256.
Materialise the six R1T novelty candidates and representation/occurrence/Development rules as proposal-only bytes.
Create machine-readable PMM-DFA programme state and current-state pointer.
Create bootstrap QA and authority records.
Establish PMM-DFA-R1T-G0 as the next operator-required gate.
explicit_non_scope: No ACTIVE_DISCOVERY, ACTIVE_DEVELOPMENT or ACTIVE_VALIDATION activation.
No protected Development source selection or access.
No Atlas accession or new immutable Atlas generation.
No semantic, family, threshold, model or theory promotion.
No provider intake, new instrument, new clock or new side.
No probability, risk, exposure, trading, execution or agent-write authority.
rollback: Delete nothing and rewrite no history. If the bootstrap proves defective before merge, close/defer the branch and retain no authority. If a defect is found after merge, supersede forward with a corrected bootstrap state; preserve the original records as historical evidence.
